Downtown.name: Downtown
Downtown.description: Old Courthouse Square core with the historic Empire building, Railroad Square adaptive reuse, and the downtown mixed-use permitting corridor.

Railroad Square.name: Railroad Square
Railroad Square.description: Historic transit-adjacent district with artisan studios, brewery taprooms, and converted warehouse retail.

West End.name: West End
West End.description: West Ninth Street corridor with bungalow infill, small-scale commercial rehab, and West End studio conversions.

Northwest Santa Rosa.name: Northwest Santa Rosa
Northwest Santa Rosa.description: Mendocino Avenue north corridor with post-war residential, Mark West business park, and Airport Boulevard industrial infill.

Larkfield-Wikiup.name: Larkfield-Wikiup
Larkfield-Wikiup.description: Unincorporated north Sonoma County suburban fringe with ranch-style homes, auto-oriented retail, and steady renovation permits.

North Santa Rosa.name: North Santa Rosa
North Santa Rosa.description: Cleveland Avenue and Mendocino Avenue north of downtown with mid-century housing stock, strip retail, and steady alteration permits.

Roseland.name: Roseland
Roseland.description: Sebastopol Road corridor with immigrant-owned small businesses, Hispanic cultural district, and the Roseland Village mixed-use node.

Southwest Santa Rosa.name: Southwest Santa Rosa
Southwest Santa Rosa.description: West College Avenue corridor with suburban residential, St. Joseph Health campus, and Yulupa Avenue retail pads.

Bennett Valley.name: Bennett Valley
Bennett Valley.description: Bennett Valley Road corridor with golf-course residential, Annadel State Park edge, and the Bennett Valley Village center.

Southeast Santa Rosa.name: Southeast Santa Rosa
Southeast Santa Rosa.description: South Avenue corridor with mid-century residential, Oliver's Market area, and Yulupa Boulevard retail.

Rincon Valley.name: Rincon Valley
Rincon Valley.description: Mission Boulevard east corridor with suburban subdivisions, Rincon Valley Library anchor, and steady new-build permit volume.

Fountaingrove.name: Fountaingrove
Fountaingrove.description: East hills master-planned community with custom homes, winery estate lots, and the Fountaingrove golf course residential belt.
